title: NPCTagToggle
body:
**This mod is archived due to the 'hide_description' data field introduced in 1.21.9 Pre-Release 1 which makes this mod useless.**

## Description
A lightweight mod that lets players toggle the "NPC" tag displayed below Mannequins' name with a single key press (default: O).
Perfect for adventure maps and custom worlds, as it helps create a more immersive experience.
